name: Ferienheim Wildmoos
beschreibung:
Enjoying a sunny hillside position in Telfs with wide vistas over the Tyrolean Inn Valley, Ferienheim Wildmoos offers comfortable lodgings for outdoor fans and families. Cosy rooms ensure deep rest in revitalising mountain air.

Hiking and mountain biking routes up the iconic Hohe Munde begin close by, with the Olympic region of Seefeld and Innsbruck city easily accessible.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienheim Wildmoos in Telfs provides a relaxing holiday retreat in the Inn Valley at the foot of the Hohe Munde.
